name: Shin Hoka no Otoko no Seieki de Harande mo Ii Desu ka...? 3 - Uwaki Shuki ni Tsuzurareta Kairaku no Tsumeato
original_name: 新・他の男の精液で孕んでもいいですか…？３ 浮気手記に綴られた快楽の爪痕
source:
The protagonist, Masato, and his girlfriend, Sayaka, were a couple with about a year of dating history. They’d met during a regional joint theater performance and had been inseparable ever since.
Though they attended different schools, they spent almost every day together at home, deepening their bond.

In the fall of their third year, Masato and Sayaka participated in their final joint theater performance as students.
But behind the scenes of rehearsals, Masato remained oblivious to the fact that Sayaka’s body was being claimed by pleasure elsewhere.

The record of betrayal—The Cheating Memoir.
Everything was written there…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011480.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公正人和女友沙耶香是一对有一年左右恋爱史的情侣。他们是在一次地区联合戏剧表演中认识的，从那以后就形影不离。
尽管他们就读于不同的学校，但他们几乎每天都在家里度过，加深了他们的联系。

第三年的秋天，雅人和沙耶香作为学生参加了最后一次联合戏剧表演。
但在排练的幕后，正人仍然没有注意到沙耶香的身体在其他地方被快乐所占据。

背叛记录——出轨回忆录。
一切都写在那里……
